movelist.name: Echoed Voice
movelist.effect: If Echoed Voice was used by any Pokémon or Trainer in the Encounter on the previous round, increase its Damage Base by +4. If Echoed Voice was used by any Pokémon or Trainers during both the previous two rounds, increase its Damage Base by +8.

movelist.name: Astonish
movelist.effect: Astonish Flinches the target on 15+. Once per scene, if the target is unaware of the user’s presence, Astonish automatically Flinches the target.

movelist.name: Supersonic
movelist.effect: The target becomes Confused. On miss, the target suffers a -2 penalty to Accuracy Rolls for one full round.

movelist.name: Screech
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Defense lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Howl
movelist.effect: The user and all allies in the Burst have their Attack CS raised by 1.

abilities.name: Soundproof
abilities.effect: The Pokémon is immune to Moves with the Sonic Keyword. Defensive.

abilities.name: Intimidate
abilities.effect: Lower the target’s Attack 1 Combat Stage. You may target a specific foe only once per Scene with Intimidate.
